scope: Phase 1 - Forensic Audit of MNA Circuit Architecture

baseline.mathematicalFormulation: Linear Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA) [G B; C D] * [v; i] = [j; e]
baseline.matrixSolver: Gaussian Elimination with partial row pivoting
baseline.convergenceHandling: N/A (Single linear pass, no iterative loop)

conservationVerification.kclResiduals: Calculated at every node; threshold <= 1e-9 A
conservationVerification.kvlChecks: Calculated across resistor branches; threshold <= 1e-9 V
conservationVerification.powerBalance: Calculated P_supplied vs P_dissipated; threshold <= 1e-9 W

deficienciesIdentified.description: Lack of nonlinear element support in canonical ReferenceCircuitModel ComponentType enum (only RESISTOR and VOLTAGE_SOURCE present).
MNA matrix assembly in NodalCircuitSolver is strictly linear and static; does not support dynamic linearization, companion models, or Newton-Raphson Jacobian stamps.
Absence of iterative numerical solver loop with convergence criteria (residual norm, update norm) and step damping/voltage limiting against exponential overflow.
Lack of diode physical equation implementation (Shockley model with saturation current Is, ideality factor n, thermal voltage Vt, and C1 continuous exponential clamping).
ElectricalCoreEngine lacks nonlinear utility calculations (diode forward voltage, dynamic conductance gd, Lambert W / iterative operating point oracle).

upgradeStrategy.architecture: Extend existing canonical ReferenceCircuitModel and NodalCircuitSolver in-place without parallel solvers or duplicate state
upgradeStrategy.nonLinearAlgorithm: Damped Newton-Raphson iteration with SPICE-style diode junction voltage limiting and analytical Jacobian
upgradeStrategy.backwardCompatibility: Purely linear circuits automatically bypass iterative loop or solve in single exact step, preserving 100% backward precision
upgradeStrategy.safetyGates: Detect non-convergence, singular Jacobian, non-finite values, and invalid parameters with failure-closed diagnostics
